propositions: Documentation for S3 ticket-store backend and optional git-remote-s3 dependency is absent from docs/config.md and docs/README.md, blocking operator discoverability and configuration.
Operators lack guidance on SSE-KMS bucket setup, IAM policy scoping, credentials trust boundary, and auto-doctor self-heal behavior (stale lock with 60s TTL, multi-bundle merge).

ADR 0093 recording the S3 backend architecture decision (git-remote-s3 choice, SSE-KMS rationale, merge-based auto-doctor vs upstream interactive doctor, rejected TTL-lowering) must be added with proper marker and regenerated index.

Documentation must clarify that GIT_REMOTE_S3_LOCK_TTL_SECONDS (not GIT_REMOTE_S3_LOCK_TTL) is the correct environment variable honored by git-remote-s3 v0.3.2 and flag version verification to remove mislead hazard.
